one_liner: Rain app creates a configurable particle system with additive blending, alpha over life, and optional texture, using a GLB model and script.
primary_use_case: Add dynamic rain-like particle effects to a Hyperfy world.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided mp4 preview (xyz-particle-demos_2_-_edit.mp4) to evaluate the rain particle effect visual quality before integrating the app.
manifest_quality_notes: Short description relies on script analysis; no explicit app documentation.
